values.note: The description lists drinking water, but the page's Current Conditions say 'Drinking water is not available.' No garbage service: pack it in, pack it out. Picnic day-use area.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/potosi-campground-and-picnic-area ('Vault toilet(s)'; Current Conditions and Water: 'Drinking water is not available.', 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'There is no garbage service at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually, from late May through mid-September weather dependent' (Seasons of Use); its Operational Hours say 'late May through mid-October weather dependent'.

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) campground on the east side of the Tobacco Root Mountains, South Willow Creek running through the middle, ~6,200 ft. From Harrison, about 7 miles west on Pony Road, then 10 miles south on South Willow Creek Road from Pony. No cell coverage. A 23-ft motorhome is just over the Forest Service's 22-ft trailer recommendation, which the curation rule accepts. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (Madison RD, updated Aug 31, 2026): confirmed free, first-come first-served, 15 sites, 22-ft trailer recommendation, vault toilets, no drinking water (derived values now manual); added season (late May - mid-September, or mid-October per Operational Hours). Not stated: stay limit. Alerts: only standing food-storage and pallet orders. Note trimmed of restated values.
